points.description: States that a very large number of hidden layers causes overfitting / high variance: the model fits training data (low training error) but does not generalise to new unseen data (high test error).
points.partial_credit: Half marks if only 'overfitting' (or high variance) is named without explaining poor generalisation or the training/test error gap.

points.description: States that training (backpropagation) becomes slow / computationally costly with many hidden layers.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if only vaguely says 'more complex' or 'takes more time' without linking to training/backpropagation.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for naming both issues: overfitting/high variance with poor generalisation, and slow backpropagation/training. Give 1 mark if only one issue is correctly given, or both are given only vaguely. Give 0 for unrelated or wrong answers (e.g. underfitting or high bias as the main issue). Accept clear synonyms.
